content.value: Derive an expression for the lattice heat capacity of a solid following l.instcin model. Discuss predictions of the model and compare it with experimental observations.

<sub>6(c)</sub> J\. <sub>copper</sub> wire of <sub>length</sub> 0.5 m long and diameter 0.3 mm has a resistance of 0.11 n at 20°C. If the thermal conductivity of copper at 20°C is 390 <sup>w111·1</sup> K-<sup>1,</sup> calculate Lorentz number.
